author: recovery_clock_review
crashBoundaryVerified: WAL metadata is only a cheap gate for opening fresh primary/witness read-only readers. It never alone authorizes readiness; the actual candidate primary key must be absent and actual witness key still present before pipeP and SIGSTOP.
No read-only DB handle is cached across primary deletion. The numeric .log map detects growth or new WAL filenames; every gate-triggered logical check reopens and closes both readers.

Production collect remains unchanged: a sync=true Write completes primary deletion then invokes its check before primary Flush and before any witness deletion. Therefore the callback can observe actual durable primary progress without staged fake deletion.

Parent still spawns fresh exec, requires actual pipeP and confirmed SIGSTOP, then SIGKILL/reap. Deadline30seconds is measured with steady_clock; EINTR cannot restart it. Separate2second SIGSTOP confirmation remains.
After SIGKILL, a fresh copied-store session and new plan must have no primary orphan but retained witness orphan; collection and allProtectedReferencesReopened remain mandatory.
naturalBoundaryVerified: Only natural-mode end grows from6epochs48slots to7epochs56slots. Participation100%, ordinary proposed/admitted blocks, pruning trigger>=2anchorMoves and source/witness/signer preservation checks remain unchanged.

Terminal guard still requires actual GC slot followed by at least2epochs16ordinary slots and a newer checkpoint, followed by cold reopen of the real following publication. If GC occurs later than40, this bound can still fail rather than silently pass.
Automatic pruning still requires at least3anchorMoves and retained-state bounds. Natural orphans must arise from publication/pruning; injectedBlobCount remains0.
New intermediate JSON reports actual GC slot/moves and explicitly has terminalQualification=false and followingPublicationColdReopened=false; it cannot substitute for the final result.
limits: No compiler, test, DB open, runtime, Docker or SSH executed by this reviewer. Only two test source files are changed; production and core archive are not changed by this patch.
WAL metadata is a test-fixture heuristic, not a production recovery predicate. It may still refuse on a missing/different WAL layout or if collection is not reached within the unchanged30s bound.
Expected GCslot40 and success within the unchanged180s CTest deadline remain execution hypotheses, not verified outcomes. Original48slot failure and parent timeout logs must remain preserved.
SIGKILL qualifies process-crash partial deletion under this one synthetic between-store case; it does not establish physical power-loss durability, live validator duties or network finality.
